candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record shows BCR/ABL1 p210 fusion with Philadelphia chromosome t(9;22)(q34;q11.2), which is the hallmark of CML; the B-lymphoid blast immunophenotype (CD34+, CD10+, CD19+, CD20−, CD33−) with 60% marrow blasts represents lymphoid blast crisis of CML, not de novo B-ALL. C001 captures the blast-phase phenotype correctly but asserts a different diagnostic entity (primary B-ALL) that is incompatible with the CML origin and blast crisis state required by the reference.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: C001 identifies the blast phenotype (B-ALL) but omits the underlying CML and the blast crisis transformation context; the reference requires CML in lymphoid blast crisis as a composite entity

case_quality_flags: p210 BCR/ABL1 is characteristic of CML blast crisis rather than de novo Ph+ B-ALL (which more commonly carries p190); this distinction supports CML in lymphoid blast crisis over primary Ph+ B-ALL
